resource_pause_policy: hold existing manual pause; stop first observed pause; no resume or retry
model_reset_policy: fresh model and app process for every slot; no OS page-cache flush; within-case KV caching uses normal server defaults
warmup_policy: llama-server default startup warmup; no doctor/chat/load-probe generation before submission
ordering: manifest case order; baseline then adaptive for even case index, adaptive then baseline for odd case index
attempt_policy: exactly one scheduled attempt per case/variant; preflight or submission failures consume a slot and remain in the accounting ledger; no replacement attempt
infrastructure_policy: stop remaining schedule on model OOM/restart, unconfirmed cleanup, unknown running work, or unsafe starting resources; remaining slots explicitly unattempted
comparison_scope: all 12 fixed synthetic tasks, 8 development and 4 heldout; 24 slots; measurement comparability is separate from output delivery and successful outcomes
quality_scope: lexical, retrieval and citation-ownership proxies only; report partial-text populations separately; no heldout tuning
